text_block_list.text:
I hear that there's a cold going around.
Then, just
as I start to think my own
throat's feeling a little
irritated...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ACHOO!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, you got sick too?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... And I usually pride myself on my
good
health. I guess I caught this from
someone.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No two ways about it, you're gonna need
this. It's
my specially made magical
cough drop! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's completely black. But it does
look
effective. Bottoms up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Blegh! What the heck is this?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It tastes like... medicine? A rubber
band? A tire?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's black licorice. Most people
here in
Japan hate how it tastes, but in
Europe it's
famous for treating coughs! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Gross or not, it really does work, you
know! So
give it a try.

A black cough drop that tastes like a
tire...
Doesn't sound too appealing,
but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you. You look like you're about to
sneeze.
Take a cough drop!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What are you getting so worked up
about? I'm
doing you a favor! Eat it
already!

With Sweep Tosho being so considerate,
I can't
refuse her. I make up my mind
and pop the black
drop into my mouth.

Augh! It tastes like medicine but it has
the texture
of a tire!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aha! ♪ I can tell from your face that it's
working
its magic!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay?! Take some deep breaths!
In! Out!
In! Out!
choice_data_list: Yeah, in more ways than one...!
Yeah, in more ways than one...!

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Sweep! You're still at it with your
infamous
magic cough drops?!

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is that trainer all right? That's a
face that
says "suffering" if I've ever seen
one!

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, riiight? I'll go get you some
water. Oh and
watch out, chewing makes
it worse!

Students begin to gather around us,
perhaps
drawn by my look of profound
discomfort.

As I drink some water and slowly regain
my
composure...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Compared to when they were
complaining
about colds and stuff,
everyone looks a little
better now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No wonder Granny always called it
magic
candy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That stuff I gave you! Granny's a great
witch, and
she told me that candy
always brings laughter.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And that laughter made everyone feel a
little
better, right? That's what my
magic's all about! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you look like you want some more.
Okay,
here's another!

Magic that brings laughter to everyone
around
you. Just as I start to think that's
actually quite a
nice idea...
choice_data_list: Then... don't mind if I do.

text_block_list.text:
...The awful taste brings tears to my
eyes!

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You should have stopped when
you had
the chance!

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, just spit it out and drink some
water!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! A licorice a day keeps the doctor
away! ♪

But I find myself completely unable to
reach out
for it... Perhaps my whole body
has been
traumatized by the taste!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why's your hand shaking like that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whatever. Okay, as an extra special
favor, I'll
leave you alone for today.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But that means the rest of you have to
eat what's
left.

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby A
text_block_list.text: What? We do?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Duh! Now open up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, fine. Okay, here it comes... BLEGH.
It tastes
just like a rubber band!

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
No way! It tastes like a tire! A really
worn-out
one!

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Come on, what does that even
mean?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aww, don't be like that.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine. Then, I'll just have to find someone
else to—
Hehe, wait just a moment there, Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've been developing a new supplement,
but the
taste has been scaring off test
subjects.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Which has me thinking now... If one were
to taste
something even worse
beforehand, that could
potentially make
the supplement taste good by

comparison.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps even this Universal Amino
Capsule will
finally be rendered edible?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, you really have a screw loose
up there.
But then again...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That sounds super fun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Then, let us begin, Sweep! Commence
pincer
attack!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: On it! Let's go!

In a merciless but splendidly
coordinated
operation, the two try to
catch me. I call for help
from Kitasan
Black and manage to escape the
ordeal
unscathed...
